column1: # sd-bus's D-Bus error name -> errno map: the ground truth for
# dbus_session_map_error() in src/dbus_session.cyr, asserted row for row
# by tests/dbus_session.tcyr and re-checked against the runner's
# libsystemd by CI (tools/sdbus_errno_probe.c reads this file and must
# print it back unchanged). Generated 2026-10-28 against libsystemd 262.
# Scope: every org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.* name in sd-bus's own map,
# every org.freedesktop.login1.* name, every System.Error.<ERRNO> name
# glibc knows plus three aliases, and names that must fall to -EIO.
# Rows on which libsystemd versions disagree are left out, so the
# table holds on both versions checked (259, 262): EFTYPE
# (errno 134) is -134 in 262 and -EIO in 259 (Ubuntu 26.04), so it is
# omitted and samvada answers -EIO, as libsystemd <= 259 does.
